name: Astron Rpa
headline: Astron-RPA: Powerful Automation Tools for Everyone
short_description: Astron-RPA is a strong RPA suite designed for automation, catering to both individuals and enterprises. With its out-of-the-box tools, it helps users to streamline processes effortlessly, whether through low-code or no-code solutions.
author: iflytek

sections.overview:
Astron-RPA is a Robotic Process Automation (RPA) suite designed to help individuals and enterprises automate business processes. The platform offers out-of-the-box tools that enable users to streamline workflows without requiring extensive coding expertise. Astron-RPA supports both low-code and no-code automation approaches, making it accessible to technical and non-technical users alike. The suite caters to organizations looking to reduce manual tasks and improve operational efficiency through automation.
Automating repetitive data entry tasks to reduce human error and save time.
Streamlining customer onboarding processes to enhance user experience and speed up service delivery.
Integrating various software applications to create seamless workflows that improve collaboration.
Generating automated reports and dashboards for real-time insights into business performance.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install iflytek/astron-rpa`
`git clone https://github.com/iflytek/astron-rpa`
sections.usage:
```
Automate the monthly expense report generation process using Astron-RPA and Productiv. The report should include [EXPENSE_CATEGORIES] and [TIME_PERIOD]. Ensure the data is pulled from Productiv and formatted according to [COMPANY_TEMPLATE]. Schedule this automation to run on the [DAY_OF_MONTH] of each month.
```
Copy

```
The Astron-RPA automation for monthly expense reports has been successfully set up. Here are the details:

1. **Data Source**: Productiv
2. **Expense Categories**: Travel, Software, Office Supplies, Marketing
3. **Time Period**: January 2024
4. **Report Format**: PDF
5. **Scheduled Day**: 1st of every month

The automation will pull the necessary data from Productiv, format it according to the company's template, and generate a PDF report. The report will be saved in the designated folder and sent to the finance team via email.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
